title: Define hosted verification records
responsibility: Defines the accepted structure of a hosted verification record and its recorded results.

outputs.name: hostedEvidenceRecord
outputs.description: A strict validation schema for record identity, passed/failed status, validity and problems; source commit and optional base; profile and timestamps; optional gate statuses; failures; tests; scenarios and captures; measurements; and budget findings. Test and scenario status values are constrained, numeric values must be finite, and shared list and text limits apply. The schema does not establish that a record is truthful.
